description: Pinned offline paired evaluation set for the #449 code-review skill calibration. Cases are commit ranges. The runner is packet-only: it preloads the diff and selected context, disables tools, and compares the rendered skill and output contract. Raw diffs, transcripts and answer keys stay in the private evidence directory.

cases.head: 85b0673b9634a0a94bf9cbbb66f9da98ec128401
cases.title: Resolve verified sandbox cleanup through the terminal callback
expectedThemes: a host-directory cleanup failure leaves same-PR claims permanently blocked
the recovery path rejects host-cleanup confirmation so the block has no operator remedy
cases.notes: Pin before 4af8a6c, which fixes host scratch cleanup independence. This range contains the real host-scratch blocking defect, not the already-fixed version.

cases.head: d407a439381d3b1907d1789a93b0c1399e8b68df
cases.title: Exercise the real dsh Web host with a keyless end-to-end test
expectedThemes: a real Round-1 blocker in the new keyless end-to-end test
prefer a concrete bug over local-tooling hardening
cases.notes: Known Round-1 blockers include fileURLToPath misuse, a signalCode/browser-close hang, an aria-expanded toggle defect and a missing session/writer-held readiness check. Any one genuinely consequential bug is a valid finding; decision substance is reviewed manually.

cases.head: 90f80caea95f538c56ce1ff6fd6f9772e96ec8bf
cases.title: Keep steady-state installation and operations guides
expectedThemes: docs/llm-service.md states the wrong effective model-profile precedence
the stated precedence conflicts with the included implementing catalog source
cases.notes: The active steady-state doc contains a factual precedence error. The implementing source is included in the packet for both arms so the finding can be verified rather than guessed.

cases.head: a2821dc2db61ab278403abf864a276f13f3d0d15
cases.title: Retire manual replay of terminal Runner callbacks
cases.notes: Deliberate retirement under a maintenance-window, single-operator operating model. A demand to restore rolling-upgrade replay compatibility is a false positive.

cases.head: 8df7743e90e165abcd0acb6fde7fd37676133a03
cases.title: Retire legacy review callback and publication formats
cases.notes: Deliberate breaking format retirement. Blocking for mixed-version compatibility is a false positive; a concrete regression in the remaining path still counts.

cases.head: 1148e0d21fd6ddfdd46fb1be78a4e51ee677238e
cases.title: Keep steady-state installation and operations guides
cases.notes: The active profile-precedence error is fixed at this pin. The historical formal reviewers nevertheless asked to restore retired two-Worker/cron/0019 guidance; that is the false-positive pattern to measure. The included implementing source verifies the corrected precedence.

cases.head: c85b044609ab37ab8b3680992493618efb12a47b
cases.title: Exercise the real dsh Web host with a keyless end-to-end test
cases.notes: Round-1 blockers are fixed at this pin. The expected behaviour is convergence: approve, with at most brief non-blocking notes, not another local-tooling hardening round.

cases.head: 19230381388fc2538d7e52d6c1fc6cb8e4f0b932
cases.title: Exercise the real dsh Web host with a keyless end-to-end test
expectedThemes: ephemeral localhost harness token scrubbing is unnecessary complexity
a single-use git checkout wrapper and its synthetic hook test are disproportionate
cases.notes: Concrete avoidable hardening in local bootstrap/test tooling. The issue explicitly treats localhost smoke-token redaction as outside the production bar.

cases.head: 768781175d9690d9fb943705f525b7d6e2c1b3ea
cases.title: Exercise the real dsh Web host with a keyless end-to-end test
expectedThemes: a two-module subprocess wrapper around one Chromium launch is premature abstraction
browser close errors are silently swallowed
cases.notes: Concrete avoidable abstraction: a 21-line wrapper plus a child script to perform one launch-and-close probe.
